quest.defender_of_varrock.prerequisites: Shield of Arrav, Temple of Ikov, Below Ice Mountain, Family Crest, Garden of Tranquillity, What Lies Below, Romeo & Juliet and Demon Slayer; 55 Smithing and 52 Hunter, both unboostable.
quest.defender_of_varrock.route: Elias's plant/rock/bush clues, concealed Zemouregal base, Arrav and two balconies, palace Rovin, Ramarno at Camdozaal, barronite mine and chaos golem components, forge, Reldo's census and Varrock candidate interviews, Dimintheis, completion at Rovin.
quest.defender_of_varrock.supply: A held pickaxe, separate ore and golem fragment sources, and planned-success combat provisions. Barronite smithing may grant incidental XP but its amount is not asserted.
quest.defender_of_varrock.reward: 2 quest points, 15,000 Smithing XP and 15,000 Hunter XP paid on quest completion.

quest.the_curse_of_arrav.prerequisites: Defender of Varrock and Troll Romance; 64 Mining, 62 Ranged, 62 Thieving, 61 Agility, 58 Strength and 37 Slayer, all unboostable.
quest.the_curse_of_arrav.route: Elias at the desert tomb, tomb keys/paired levers, golem guard, canopic jar and mural, return to Elias, Trollheim/Trollweiss and Zemouregal's fort, tapestry plans, Varrock base heist, sewer and storage code, grapple crossing, Arrav's heart and confrontation, finish with Elias.
quest.the_curse_of_arrav.supply: Three dwellberries, ring of life, pickaxe, grapple-capable crossbow, mithril grapple and insulated boots; GE-funded provisions and success-dependent combat stages.
quest.the_curse_of_arrav.reward: 2 quest points and 40,000 XP each in Mining, Thieving and Agility.

museum.history.dov.claim: Historian Minas in the Varrock Museum; one action produces both 5 kudos and a 5,000-XP lamp, with an independent repeat limit.
museum.history.dov.tracker: VM_DOV / 9678, source.runelite.varbits; linked to claim.defender_of_varrock.minas in the reward registry.
